usage: llm-modelbench diff [-h] --a A --b B [--out OUT]
                           [--noise-band NOISE_BAND]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --a A                 first run directory
  --b B                 second run directory
  --out OUT             output markdown path, default: <b>/diff.md
  --noise-band NOISE_BAND
                        label deltas within this repeatability band as
                        tied/noise-band
